purpose: Forty real initiatives for relevance labels: each one is a public Certified project record, its description the passages Weave lists publicly, verbatim. A person judges whether each program in its pool fits.
authoring: Built on 23 November 2026 from packages/api/evaluation/partner-real-v1-corpus.json (collected 19 November 2026). Countries are assumed from the places the passages name, and left empty where they name none; applicant type is unknown for all. No themes, as a card confirmed on the describe step holds none since DL-127. The 40 were read for names of people before use.

initiatives.name: Connecting Global Carbon Data with Local Community Knowledges in Indonesia
initiatives.description: Mapping the carbon sequestration potential of global biodiversity hotspots like the Amazon, the Indonesian archipelago and the Congo Basin is of critical interest to climate science, climate policy, and climate finance. But the carbon conversation is alien to forest dwelling communities; their priorities are first and foremost livelihoods that are at risk from extraction, the climate crisis, and lack of legal territorial rights.

initiatives.name: Restoring San Antonio's drylands, Tamaulipas

Durante años, la comunidad ha enfrentado los efectos de las sequías prolongadas, la pérdida de cobertura vegetal y el deterioro de los recursos naturales, lo que ha afectado tanto el equilibrio ecológico como las actividades productivas locales.
